document_notes: Page 265 of PIR contains entries for ATILIVS, specifically M. Atilius Postumus Bradua (1303), T. Atilius Rufus (1304), and T. Atilius Rufus Titianus (1305). Only T. Atilius Rufus (1304) is relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus as he is explicitly attested as legatus Aug. pro pr. of Pannonia and Syria.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as Legatus Aug. pro pr. Pannoniae and Legatus Aug. pro pr. Syriae.

notes: Attested by military diploma dated 13 June 80 AD (dipl. mil. datum d. 13. m. Iunii a. 80).
Attested by a milestone (cippus miliarius) published in Palestine Explor. Fund 1924, 94 = AE 1925, 95.
Died in office in the province in 84 AD according to Tacitus (Agr. 40).
